title: Silky water
summary: Smooth waterfalls and seas with an ND filter.

blocks.note: Waterfall: 0.5–2 s. Sea flattened to mist: 15–30 s.

blocks.text: Work out the shutter with your ND filter

steps: Frame and focus **without** the filter, then switch to manual focus.
Meter without the filter and note the shutter speed.
Use the ND calculator to get the new shutter speed and set it.
Use the 2 s timer or a remote so you don't shake the camera.
Check the histogram. Adjust the shutter if needed.

items: Overcast days make it easier: less light and softer contrast.
Over 30 s, switch to Bulb mode and time it with a remote.
Wipe spray off the filter between shots.
